_register: Formal polite address (second person plural, « dumneavoastră » never « tu ») in sentences addressed to the reader, with the imperative plural for instructions (Introduceți, Scanați codul de bare); buttons use the short plural imperative (Salvați, Împrumutați, Anulați) and menu entries and headings use nouns or verbal nouns (Împrumuturi, Restituire, Configurare); no jokes, no exclamation marks; always the comma-below letters ș and ț (never the cedilla forms ş and ţ).
_quotes: Romanian low-high quotation marks „text” (U+201E opening, U+201D closing); quotes nested inside them use guillemets « » ; the space before : ; ? ! is not used; decimal comma and a full stop or space for thousands; the arrow → stays.
_plural: Three forms: one (exactly 1), few (0 and 2 to 19, also any number ending in 01 to 19), other (20 and above, which takes « de » before the noun: « 1 elev », « 5 elevi », « 25 de elevi »); the form « other » must therefore include « de » in the phrase.

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode; plural « exemplare ».

record.note: The catalogue entry of a title; short form « înregistrare » (plural « înregistrări ») where the context is clear. « Fișă » is the old card-catalogue word and is not used.

patron.note: The usual word in Romanian school and public libraries (« fișa cititorului »); « utilizator » is used by Koha and by university libraries but is also the word for a software user, so it is avoided. Plural « cititori »; feminine « cititoare » only where the gender is known.

card.note: Short form « legitimație » where the context is clear; « card » is not used.

return.note: The action: « Restituire » on the menu, « restituiți » on a button, « a restitui » for the verb; the Romanian library word, not « returnare ».

renew.note: Extending the due date; verb « a prelungi ». Romanian libraries say « prelungirea împrumutului »; « reînnoire » is not used.

due date.note: Short form « termen » only where the context is clear.

overdue.note: Use « întârziat » (agreeing with the noun: împrumut întârziat, carte întârziată) for a loan or a book and « în întârziere » for a patron or a state; « restanță » is the legal word for an overdue item and is avoided.

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return; « somație » is used by Romanian libraries but is a legal summons and too harsh for pupils, so it is not used.

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (« cota cărții »), as in Romanian libraries; plural « cote ».

spine band.note: The coloured band on the spine with the pictogram and the cotă.

class.note: A school class (« clasa a 3-a B »); plural « clase ».

group.note: Used for a group of teachers; plural « grupuri ».

reading level.note: The school year a book is meant for.

classification.note: The sorting scheme; for non-fiction Romanian libraries use CZU (Clasificarea Zecimală Universală), the Romanian form of the Dewey-like decimal scheme, so a mention of Dewey may be written « CZU / Dewey ».

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; « recolarea colecțiilor » is the Romanian library term. « Inventar » is the register of acquisitions in Romanian libraries, so it is not used here.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; singular « sugestie de achiziție ».

census.note: Registering the cititori with their photo; « recensământ foto » in a menu.

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year; short form « trecerea la clasa următoare » for a button or title.

anonymise.note: Verb « a anonimiza »; erasing the personal data for good.

backup.note: Plural « copii de siguranță »; « backup » is understood but is not used. Never confuse with « exemplar » (a book copy).

colour set.note: A palette of the interface; written « culori ».

print list.note: « Tipărire » is used for printing a document as in Romanian software; « imprimare » is not used.

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; full form « scaner de coduri de bare ». « Cititor de coduri de bare » is the formal name but clashes with « cititor » for patron, so « scaner » is used in labels and in text.

demo data.note: The invented school the program can fill itself with.

student.note: Feminine « elevă » only where the gender is known; plural « elevi ».

teacher.note: Plural « profesori »; « cadru didactic » (plural « cadre didactice ») is the gender-neutral formal word and may be used in longer texts, but the label is « profesor »; in primary school « învățător » is not used.

template.note: Print template: « șablon de tipărire »; plural « șabloane ».

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled; the area as a whole is « Împrumuturi ».
